subject: Re: Request for audit log snapshot and delivery options (Acme Bio)
messages:
From: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@acmebio.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: audits@acmebio.com, legal@acmebio.com
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: full admin + API access logs (SIG/SOC2 evidence)

Hi Olga,

As part of our SIG/SOC2 review, Acme Bio needs a dated export of Redwood admin activity and API access logs covering 2027-02-01 through 2027-03-31. We need the following:
- NDJSON preferred; each record with timestamp (ISO8601), principal (user/service), action, resource, resource_id, request_id, src_ip, user_agent, request_body (if available), response_status, response_body (redacted ok).
- Evidence of admin console actions (user invites, role changes, policy updates) and API key lifecycle events.
- Chain-of-custody note on how the export was produced and checksum for delivered bundle.

Can Redwood provide: 1) a short summary of export formats supported and 2) earliest ETA for delivery? Our auditors requested the files and a contact for any follow-up. Tight timeline — they'd like a deliverable by 2027-04-22 if feasible.

I attached the SIG matrix we are filling out. Please let me know if you need a PO.

Thanks,
Dana Lopez
Security Program Manager
Acme Bio

Attachments: SIG-questionnaire-AcmeBio.xlsx
From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@acmebio.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: full admin + API access logs (SIG/SOC2 evidence)

Hi Dana — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver the export you described. High-level delivery options and considerations below (pick one and we'll start the snapshot):

1) Console snapshot (quick):
   - Format: NDJSON or CSV, split by day (ndjson recommended for nested fields).
   - Coverage: admin activity (console actions), API access logs, auth events.
   - Delivery: single password-protected ZIP with sha256 checksum, available for download from Redwood Console for 7 days.
   - ETA: ~48–72 hours after confirmation of timeframe.

2) Managed S3 export (recommended for large sets):
   - Format: NDJSON + gz compression.
   - Delivery: we upload to customer-owned S3 bucket (requires cross-account role) or to our temporary bucket with pre-signed URL.
   - ETA: 24–48 hours if cross-account role already provisioned; otherwise allow time for role setup.

3) Admin-API snapshot (programmatic):
   - We issue snapshot_id and the export is accessible via signed URL or API GET.
   - Sample: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/snapshots/{snapshot_id}?format=ndjson&include=request_body,response_body"

Important notes:
- By default we redact PII from response bodies; raw request/response bodies can be included if Acme confirms a data-processing agreement and scope.
- Retention: our standard audit log retention is 13 months; if you need older data we will need to escalate.
- Chain-of-custody: we include export meta (snapshot_id, generated_by, generated_at, sha256, export_query).

Please confirm: (A) which delivery option you prefer, (B) exact date range (you listed Feb 1–Mar 31), and (C) whether you require raw request/response bodies. Once confirmed we will generate the snapshot and share delivery details.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance (sales-support)
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

Technical runbook (for our internal steps and for Acme if they want self-serve):

- If Acme provides an AWS account ID and a cross-account role ARN, we will:
  1) Create snapshot job: POST /v1/admin/snapshots with body {"range": ["2027-02-01","2027-03-31"], "types": ["admin_activity","api_access"], "format": "ndjson", "include": ["request_body","response_body"] }
  2) On completion, upload to s3://acme-accts-exports/redwood/acme-logs-202702-03/ with path manifest and checksum.
  3) Generate pre-signed GET URLs valid 14 days.
- If customer prefers our bucket + pre-signed URL, we'll sign and deliver the bundle with sha256.

Practical tips:
- NDJSON keeps request/response as JSON blobs; use gz compression.
- For large volumes (>100M events) recommend splitting by day/hour.
- We can redaction-mask JSON keys matching PII patterns (email, ssn) but need written confirmation.

I can produce a short script (aws role creation steps + snapshot POST) and share it in the HubSpot ticket (HS-32455).

— Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
